items.statement: The independently computed interaction-energy pattern supports the reported anion comparison.
items.expected: AI-[OTf]-, AI-[BF4]- and AI-Br- are close in interaction strength to AI2, while AI-[NF2]-, AI-[NTf2]-, AI-[NNf2]- and AI-[DCA]- are less negative than AI2 within the stated comparison scope.

items.statement: The result is an isolated-cluster interaction-energy comparison, not a direct prediction of solution dimerization constants.
items.expected: The report states this physical and measurement limitation.
